For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

translations.web: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.
translations.bsb: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.
translations.kjv: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
translations.asv: The waters wear the stones; The overflowings thereof wash away the dust of the earth: So thou destroyest the hope of man.
